<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="revolution-bars" class="pvme-source-title"><ins><nowiki>Revolution Bars</nowiki></ins></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<blockquote><nowiki>
</nowiki><p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>PvME is open-source! If you have a suggested improvement, use </nowiki><span><nowiki>#suggestions</nowiki></span></em></p><nowiki>
</nowiki></blockquote>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This channel lists the recommended Action Bars to use in Revolution combat mode (see section </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Configuring Revolution+</nowiki></strong><nowiki> later in this channel for more info).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>The different combinations of bars are:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Single-target </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137770977506369596.png?v=1" alt="singletarget" title="singletarget" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (e.g., most bosses)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Multi-target </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137770974431944835.png?v=1" alt="multitarget" title="multitarget" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (e.g., slayer mobs)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ 2-handed (only one weapon can be equipped)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Dual-wield (where two weapons can be equipped, one in each hand)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>If a combination is not displayed, it means the bar scored poorly in tests and is not worth using.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="disclaimer"><ins><nowiki>Disclaimer</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>No revolution bar is perfect for every situation - unless you have accessibility needs, we strongly recommend learning full manual to gain total control over which abilities are fired when. You can find more information in </nowiki><span><nowiki>#revo-to-full-manual</nowiki></span></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Variances may include:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Single-target </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137770977506369596.png?v=1" alt="singletarget" title="singletarget" kind="icon" /><nowiki> bars performing differently based on duration of the fight</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Testing was conducted at both War's Retreat dummies and Vindicta</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Multi-target </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137770974431944835.png?v=1" alt="multitarget" title="multitarget" kind="icon" /><nowiki> bars performing differently based on the number of enemies surrounding you, and their life points</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Multi-target testing was conducted at Abyssal Beasts in the Sunken Pyramid</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="configuring-revolution"><ins><nowiki>Configuring Revolution++</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div style="background-color: rgb(0, 153, 255)"></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>



</nowiki><div><div><div><nowiki>For all bars that are not marked as </nowiki><code><nowiki>Basics only</nowiki></code><nowiki>, follow the below instructions to set up properly
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Toggle on Auto-retaliate </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1084799717726228530.png?v=1" alt="autoretaliate" title="autoretaliate" kind="icon" /><nowiki> next to your adrenaline bar
⬥ Open Settings and search for </nowiki><code><nowiki>'action bar'</nowiki></code><nowiki>
⬥ Toggle on </nowiki><code><nowiki>Revolution Combat Mode</nowiki></code><nowiki>
⬥ Select </nowiki><code><nowiki>Automatically trigger</nowiki></code><nowiki> for all 4 ability types
</nowiki></div></div></div><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><span><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/gZRHfnzUKt.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></span><nowiki>

</nowiki></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div>
<nowiki>
